requirements.statement: A user signs in securely so their lists and tasks are private to them and the people they choose to share with

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor cannot view any list or task data
A signed-in user only sees lists they own or are a collaborator on

requirements.statement: A user can create a to-do list

criteria.must: A user can create a new list by naming it
The created list appears in the creator's list of lists with them as owner

requirements.statement: A user can invite another user to a list by username so they can work the same tasks together

criteria.must: The list owner can invite another user to the list by entering that user's username
Inviting a username that does not exist is rejected with a clear error
Once invited, the invited user can see and access the shared list

requirements.statement: A user can add a task to a list with a title, due date, and priority

criteria.must: A user can add a task with a title
A user can optionally set a due date on a task
A user can set a priority level (low, medium, or high) on a task

requirements.statement: A user can mark a task as done or not done so the list reflects real progress

criteria.must: A user can mark an incomplete task as done
A user can mark a completed task as not done again

requirements.statement: A user can edit or delete a task so the list stays accurate

criteria.must: A user can edit a task's title, due date, or priority
A user can delete a task, and it no longer appears on the list

requirements.statement: A user can view a list's tasks sorted or filtered by due date or priority

criteria.must: A user can sort a list's tasks by due date
A user can sort a list's tasks by priority
A user can filter a list's tasks by priority level

requirements.statement: A user can see who else has access to a shared list

criteria.must: A user viewing a shared list can see the list of collaborators and the owner

requirements.statement: A user can remove a collaborator from a list they own, or leave a list someone else owns, so access stays current

criteria.must: A list owner can remove a collaborator from their list
A removed collaborator no longer has access to the list
A collaborator can leave a list they do not own
A collaborator cannot remove another collaborator or the owner from a list they do not own

requirements.statement: A user can delete a list they own so they can remove lists no longer needed

criteria.must: A list owner can delete their list
A deleted list no longer appears for the owner or any of its collaborators
A collaborator cannot delete a list they do not own
